title: Paste primary selection (highlighted text) in Wayland
summary: Use wl-paste --primary to output the text you have currently highlighted (selected) with your mouse. This is distinct from the standard clipboard copy/paste.

steps.explain: Run wl-paste with the --primary flag to print the current primary selection (highlighted text) to the terminal.
steps.expect: The text you have currently highlighted with your mouse appears in the terminal.
